84 yo F with metastatic NSCLC, aspiration pneumonia, worsening hypoxemia.

A/P:
# Hypoxemic resp failure: on NRB, sats 86-89%. No escalation.
# Pain/dyspnea: morphine gtt titrate to comfort, glycopyrrolate PRN secretions.
# FEN: d/c IVF, d/c labs.

Code status: CMO
Dispo: ICU, expected death in house

MICU Progress Note
84 yo F with metastatic NSCLC, aspiration pneumonia, worsening hypoxemia.

A/P:
# Goals: Met with son [**Name (NI) 1182**] (HCP) and granddaughter at bedside. Explained that her lung cancer has progressed and she is not expected to recover from this pneumonia. Son said she told him she never wanted to be on a breathing machine. Family agreed to transition to comfort measures only.
# Dyspnea: morphine gtt titrate to comfort.

Code status: CMO
Dispo: ICU

Physician Progress Note
72 yo M with ESRD on HD, ischemic cardiomyopathy, admitted with VT storm, now s/p ablation.

A/P:
# VT: amiodarone gtt, no further events overnight.
# ESRD: HD today per renal.
# Communication: Wife called this AM, updated on overnight events and HD plan; all questions answered. Family meeting scheduled for tomorrow 2pm with palliative care to discuss goals of care.

Code status: Full code (to be readdressed at family meeting)

Physician Progress Note
72 yo M with ESRD on HD, ischemic cardiomyopathy, admitted with VT storm, now s/p ablation.

A/P:
# VT: amiodarone gtt, no further events overnight.
# Communication: Spoke with wife at bedside about his prognosis; explained his heart function is very poor and further VT is likely. She said he has told her he would not want CPR or to be shocked again. She would like to think it over with their daughter; will meet again tomorrow to finalize code status.

Code status: Full code for now

Social Work Note
Pt is a 79 yo F admitted with stroke, aphasic. SW met with pt's niece [**Name (NI) 3390**] at bedside. Provided emotional support and parking/lodging resources. Niece asked about rehab options; SW reviewed SNF list and insurance coverage. Niece to tour facilities this weekend. SW will continue to follow for d/c planning.
